purpose: Lock stable placeholder asset identities, engine-facing dimensions, layout contracts and replacement metadata before gameplay implementation or final visual production.

workflow.finalArt: deferred until complete game ZIP is returned for the dedicated visual replacement pass
workflow.replacementTarget: original Plushbound visual identity with polished MV-cover/Trinity-inspired JRPG presentation
workflow.rule: A placeholder may be replaced visually later without changing its logical ID, engine role, expected dimensions, frame contract or consuming references.

engineContracts.transparency: PNG-compatible alpha wherever the asset category requires cutout transparency

tiles.replacementInvariant: tile footprint and engine-facing sheet role must remain compatible

autotiles.replacementInvariant: neighbor joining behavior must remain compatible

characters.replacementInvariant: frame count, direction order, cell dimensions and anchor behavior must not silently change

portraits.replacementInvariant: subject and expression binding remain stable

guardians.replacementInvariant: Guardian identity and gameplay-facing silhouette must remain recognizable across all subassets

enemies.replacementInvariant: combat footprint and telegraph readability remain stable

bosses.replacementInvariant: phase count and telegraph meaning cannot be altered by visual replacement

equipment.replacementInvariant: appearance may improve while equipment identity and slot remain unchanged

vfx.replacementInvariant: timing and gameplay readability remain compatible

ui.replacementInvariant: interaction bounds and information hierarchy remain stable

audio.replacementInvariant: usage role and loop expectations remain stable

characterCreator.replacementRule: final artwork must preserve layer registration across compatible creator parts

rules: Canonical OCs receive unique logical IDs and are never generated from ambient NPC recipes.
Lily spelling uses one L after the initial capital L.
Child depictions and wardrobe remain age-appropriate.
Final visual pass must preserve established character identity rather than replacing canonical OCs with generic regional designs.

guardianEthics.craftingMaterials: bonding, care, gifts, shedding and environmental discovery rather than killing Guardians

qualityGates: Every placeholder has a stable logical ID before game development begins.
Every engine-facing visual has an explicit dimensions or layout contract.
Every animated sheet records frame and direction expectations.
Every regional asset resolves through the same namespace rules.
No placeholder is described as final artwork.
No proprietary RPG Maker artwork is bundled as project-owned art.
Children and age-banded creator assets remain age-appropriate.
Guardian and enemy silhouettes remain clearly distinguishable.
UI assets remain readable and usable on Android-sized displays.
Final visual replacement can occur without renaming stable IDs or rewriting gameplay references.
nextAssetOnlySteps: Populate concrete manifest records from all regional and global production specifications.
Generate or stage engine-safe placeholder files for every required manifest record.
Run naming, dimensions, transparency, sheet-layout and missing-reference validation.
Package the validated assets-only library without beginning gameplay implementation.
